perks.name: Kill Clip

perks.name: Rimestealer

perks.name: Desperado

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:

perks.name: Desperate Measures

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Swashbuckler

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.desc: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 139 from 13 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0m6Sfdv88fNZmYm9A6PdVR?si=140d643338154357) with @ImpetusAlways @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with stasis builds. Liminal Vigil is the only Stasis Heavy Burst sidearm currently in the game - the intrinsic frame perk reduces flinch slightly when you're ADSing. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 58 Range equates to 15.98m ADS and 13.32m hipfire before damage dropoff, 39 Stability is ×1.1427 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 30 Handling is 0.33s ready, 0.27s ADS and 0.36s stow speed, 20 Reload Speed is a 1.91s reload, Recoil Direction is 94, Zoom is 12, and magazine size is 26 (max 40). A little bit of Stability and Handling from the barrel perk are useful to improve gunfeel and control, particularly if you're spamming shots. For the magazine perk, the combat effect magazines all add utility, or look to speed up the reload a bit. For Stasis builds, the combination of Headstone and Rimestealer should generate crystals and shards to proc fragment effects, and apply Frost Armor to help keep you alive while you're in CQC. The Tex Balanced Stock is there if you like hipfiring, but the Gravity Well origin trait can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Stasis Shards or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

For general all-purpose use, the combination of Headstone to create a shatterable Stasis crystal on crit kills, or Attrition Orbs to generate power orbs for landing 2/3-ish of your magazine on target to proc Armour and Artifact mods or fragments effects work well. For damage, Desperate Measures provides up to ×1.3 damage with a combination of weapon and ability kills. The Tex Balanced Stock is there if you like hipfiring, but the Gravity Well origin trait can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Stasis Shards or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "True story, I had yet to have a Liminal Vigil drop until Rite of the Nine! Anyways, this Heavy Burst sidearm has some interesting perks to choose from: the obvious stasis wombo-combo, EA + KC, or the potential of Attrition Orbs and Desperate Measures feeding orbs into your abilities which in turn feed a damage buff. Heavy Burst suffer from poor Handling and Reload, so feel free to increase those as you see fit." Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I've not done a ton of PvP with Heavy Burst sidearms, but Liminal Vigil does pack some potency in its perks. Perpetual Motion and Kill Clip feels quite free and synergizes nicely (A BLISTERING .47s TTK no less!). While the range is decent, the handling is quite poor, so definitely work to bring that up if at all possible." Recommended MW: Range or Handling

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Luminal Vigil might be the strongest sidearm to date. Headstone and desperado on an aggressive burst are fantastic. You could also opt for surrounded or swashbuckler for more specific damage bonuses, but both headstone and desperado requiring a crit kill makes it easy. See a crystal? Reload for speedy quick shooting." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Luminal Vigil will continue its dominance in PvP. Rangefinder will push out its effective range enough to be viable against some submachine guns. Tap the trigger or headstone for bonus accuracy or stasis crystals. Kill clip for easy damage. Desperado for Luminal Vigil, the machine gun. All fantastic perks that are wrapped up into the Crimson Chin." Recommended MW - Range.
